name.value: LIC's Linked Accidental Death Benefit Rider

linked_or_non_linked.value: linked rider, individual life rider; charge cancelled from units

attached_to_ulips.note: Named by Nivesh Plus, SIIP, Index Plus and Protection Plus. New Pension Plus names none.

accidental_death.value: A sum equal to the accident benefit sum assured on death by accident within 180 days. The base policy must be in force at the time of the accident.
accidental_death.quote: a sum equal to the Accident Benefit Sum

other.value: No maturity, paid-up or surrender value. Can be cancelled any time but not re-opted.
other.quote: No maturity benefit is payable under this Rider

rider_term.value: (70 minus age at entry) years or the base plan policy term, whichever is less; minimum 5 years. Rider cover ceases at age 70.

premium_paying_rules.value: No separate premium. Charged monthly through unit cancellation. Can be opted at commencement or at any time during the policy term.
premium_paying_rules.quote: This rider can be opted at any time during the term of the policy or

sum_assured_limits.value: Minimum Rs 10,000, multiples of Rs 5,000. Maximum aggregate accident benefit across all LIC policies on one life: Rs 100 lakh (Rs 200 lakh including Jeevan Shiromani).

premium_deduction.value: Rs 0.40 per thousand accident benefit sum assured a year (Rs 0.80 for police duty), levied monthly by cancelling units out of the policyholder fund value.
